questions.question: Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) are contained in which part and article range of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The DPSP are embodied in Articles 36 to 51 under Part IV of the Constitution, acting as guidelines for the state in law-making and policy formulation. DPSP

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान के भाग IV के तहत अनुच्छेद 36 से 51 में सन्निहित हैं, जो कानून बनाने और नीति निर्माण में राज्य के लिए दिशानिर्देश के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

questions.question: From which country's constitution was the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) borrowed and incorporated into the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The concept of DPSP was taken from the Constitution of Ireland. They were described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Novel features' of the Indian Constitution. DPSP

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
की अवधारणा को आयरलैंड के संविधान से लिया गया था। डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर ने इन्हें भारतीय संविधान की 'नवीन विशेषताएँ' बताया था।

questions.question: What is the legal nature of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)?

options.b: Non-justiciable, cannot be enforced by any court
options.c: Justiciable only if Fundamental Rights are violated

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 37 states that DPSP are non-justiciable, meaning a citizen cannot compel the state to follow them, unlike Fundamental Rights. They are, however, fundamental to the governance of the country.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 37 कहता है कि DPSP गैर-न्यायसंगत हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि मौलिक अधिकारों के विपरीत, कोई नागरिक राज्य को उनका पालन करने के लिए मजबूर नहीं कर सकता। हालांकि, वे देश के शासन के लिए मौलिक हैं।

questions.question: The provision for a 'Uniform Civil Code for the country' (Article 44) is classified under which category of Directive Principles?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Principles focused on individual rights, liberties, and modern administrative setup, such as a Uniform Civil Code and separation of judiciary from executive, fall under the Liberal-Intellectual category.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
व्यक्तिगत अधिकारों, स्वतंत्रताओं और आधुनिक प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था पर केंद्रित सिद्धांत, जैसे समान नागरिक संहिता और न्यायपालिका का कार्यपालिका से पृथक्करण, उदार-बौद्धिक श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आते हैं।

questions.question: Which Article, classified under the Gandhian Principles, mandates the state to organize Village Panchayats and endow them with powers of self-government?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 40, a key Gandhian DPSP, aims to establish Village Panchayats as units of self-government, reflecting Mahatma Gandhi's vision of decentralized power

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 40, एक प्रमुख गांधीवादी DPSP, ग्राम पंचायतों को स्वशासन की इकाइयों के रूप में स्थापित करने का लक्ष्य रखता है, जो महात्मा गांधी के विकेन्द्रीकृत शक्ति के दृष्टिकोण को दर्शाता है।

questions.question:
Which Article among the Socialistic principles of DPSP ensures 'Equal pay for equal work for all men and women'?
DPSP
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 39 lays down several principles of policy to be followed by the State, including securing the right to adequate means of livelihood and ensuring equal pay for equal work for both sexes

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 39 राज्य द्वारा अनुपालन की जाने वाली नीति के कई सिद्धांतों को निर्धारित करता है, जिसमें आजीविका के पर्याप्त साधनों का अधिकार सुरक्षित करना और दोनों लिंगों के लिए समान कार्य के लिए समान वेतन सुनिश्चित करना शामिल है।

questions.question: Fundamental Duties (FD) were added to the Constitution under which Part and Article?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Fundamental Duties were not part of the original constitution. They were added later through the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976, and placed in Part IVA under Article 51A

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौलिक कर्तव्य मूल संविधान का हिस्सा नहीं थे। उन्हें बाद में 42वें संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 के माध्यम से जोड़ा गया और अनुच्छेद 51A के तहत भाग IVA में रखा गया।

questions.question: The concept of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution was inspired by which country?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Fundamental Duties were not originally a part of the Indian Constitution, but they were later added based on the model from the constitution of the former USSR (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics)

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौलिक कर्तव्य मूल रूप से भारतीय संविधान का हिस्सा नहीं थे, लेकिन बाद में उन्हें पूर्व USSR (सोवियत समाजवादी गणराज्यों का संघ) के संविधान के मॉडल के आधार पर जोड़ा गया था।

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added the Directive Principle 'Free Legal Aid' (Article 39A) to the Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added four new DPSP to the list, including Art 39A (Free legal aid to the poor). It also added Art 43A and Art 48A. 1976

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
के 42वें संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम ने सूची में चार नए DPSP जोड़े, जिसमें अनुच्छेद 39A (गरीबों को निःशुल्क कानूनी सहायता) शामिल है। इसने अनुच्छेद 43A और अनुच्छेद 48A को भी जोड़ा।

questions.question: What is the current total number of Fundamental Duties enshrined in the Indian Constitution under Article 51A?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Swaran Singh Committee recommended 8 duties, but 10 were initially added by the 42nd CA. The 11th duty (Art 51A(k)) was added later by the 86th CA, 2002, bringing the total to 11

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वर्ण सिंह समिति ने 8 कर्तव्यों की सिफारिश की थी, लेकिन 42वें संशोधन द्वारा शुरू में 10 जोड़े गए थे। 11वां कर्तव्य (अनुच्छेद 51A(k)) बाद में 86वें संशोधन, 2002 द्वारा जोड़ा गया, जिससे कुल संख्या 11 हो गई।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the nature of DPSPs:
DPSP
1. DPSPs are positive obligations, mandating the state to take specific actions.
2. Courts can invalidate laws violating DPSP directly.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
DPSPs are positive obligations that impose duties on the state to achieve socio-economic goals. However, they are non-justiciable, and courts generally cannot invalidate laws for violating DPSP directly, but may uphold laws aimed at fulfilling them. DPSP

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सकारात्मक दायित्व हैं जो सामाजिक-आर्थिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए राज्य पर कर्तव्य लगाते हैं। हालांकि, वे गैर-न्यायसंगत हैं, और न्यायालय सामान्य तौर पर सीधे DPSP का उल्लंघन करने वाले कानूनों को अमान्य नहीं कर सकते, लेकिन उनका उद्देश्य पूरा करने वाले कानूनों को बरकरार रख सकते हैं।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): According to the Champakam Dorairajan Case (1951), Fundamental Rights would prevail over Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).
 Reason (R): DPSPs are supported by legal sanctions, whereas Fundamental Rights are supported by moral and political sanctions.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Statement A is true as the SC ruled that FRs prevail over DPSP. However, the reason R is false; DPSP are supported by moral/political sanctions, while FRs are backed by legal sanctions

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कथन A सत्य है क्योंकि SC ने फैसला सुनाया था कि FRs, DPSP पर प्रभावी होंगे। हालाँकि, कारण R असत्य है; DPSP नैतिक/राजनीतिक प्रतिबंधों द्वारा समर्थित हैं, जबकि FRs कानूनी प्रतिबंधों द्वारा समर्थित हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Fundamental Duties:
1. They are statutory but non-enforceable in a court of law.
2. They are applicable to both Indian citizens and foreigners.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Fundamental Duties are statutory obligations but are non-enforceable, unlike Fundamental Rights. Crucially, they are only applicable to Indian citizens and not to foreigners (aliens)

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौलिक कर्तव्य सांविधिक दायित्व हैं लेकिन मौलिक अधिकारों के विपरीत, गैर-प्रवर्तनीय हैं। महत्वपूर्ण रूप से, वे केवल भारतीय नागरिकों पर लागू होते हैं, विदेशियों पर नहीं।

questions.question:
Which of the following principles were added to the DPSP by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976?
1. Securing opportunities for healthy development of children (Art 39(f)).
2. Protection and improvement of the environment and safeguarding of forests and wildlife (Art 48A).
3. Securing participation of workers in the management of industries (Art 43A).
4. Minimising inequalities in income, status, facilities, and opportunities (Art 38).
 Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Art 39(f), 48A, and 43A were added by the 42nd CA, 1976. The principle of minimising inequalities in income, status, facilities, and opportunities (Art 38) was added later by the 44th CA, 1978

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 39(f), 48A, और 43A को 42वें संशोधन, 1976 द्वारा जोड़ा गया था। आय, स्थिति, सुविधाओं और अवसरों में असमानताओं को कम करने का सिद्धांत (अनुच्छेद 38) बाद में 44वें संशोधन, 1978 द्वारा जोड़ा गया था।

questions.question:
Which pair correctly represents the primary focus of the DPSP classifications?
DPSP

options.a: Socialistic: Emphasis on individual rights and liberties; Liberal-Intellectual: Emphasis on Socio-economic justice.
options.b: Gandhian: Promotion of international peace and security; Liberal-Intellectual: Prohibition of intoxicating drinks.
options.c: Socialistic: Emphasis on socio-economic justice; Liberal-Intellectual: Focuses on individual rights and liberties.
options.d: Gandhian: Protection of monuments; Socialistic: Separation of Judiciary from Executive.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Socialistic DPSPs emphasize the welfare of the state and socio-economic justice. Liberal-Intellectual DPSPs focus on individual rights, liberties, and principles of administration, such as a Uniform Civil Code

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समाजवादी DPSP राज्य के कल्याण और सामाजिक-आर्थिक न्याय पर जोर देते हैं। उदार-बौद्धिक DPSP व्यक्तिगत अधिकारों, स्वतंत्रताओं और प्रशासन के सिद्धांतों, जैसे समान नागरिक संहिता पर केंद्रित हैं।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The subject matter of Article 45 of the DPSP was changed by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002.
 Reason (R): The original provision was replaced to make 'Early childhood care for 0-6 years' the responsibility of the State.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 86th CA, 2002, made primary education a Fundamental Right (Art 21A), necessitating the change in Art 45 from 'Free compulsory education for children up to 14 yrs' to 'Early childhood care for 0-6 yrs'. 86

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वें संशोधन, 2002 ने प्राथमिक शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A) बना दिया, जिसके कारण अनुच्छेद 45 में '14 वर्ष तक के बच्चों के लिए मुफ्त अनिवार्य शिक्षा' को बदलकर '0-6 वर्ष के बच्चों की प्रारंभिक बाल्यावस्था देखभाल' करना आवश्यक हो गया।

questions.question:
Which of the following descriptions or comments on DPSP is correctly matched with its proponent?
DPSP

options.a: Manifesto of aims and aspirations - K. T. Shah
options.b: Conscience of Constitution - B. N. Rau
options.c: Novel feature of Constitution - B. R. Ambedkar
options.d: Check payable by the bank at its own convenience - Granville Austine

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar described DPSP as the 'Novel feature of Constitution'. Granville Austine called them the 'Conscience of Constitution', and K. T. Shah described them as a 'Check payable by the bank at its own convenience'

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर ने DPSP को 'संविधान की नवीन विशेषता' बताया। ग्रानविले ऑस्टिन ने इन्हें 'संविधान की अंतरात्मा' कहा, और के. टी. शाह ने इन्हें 'बैंक द्वारा अपनी सुविधा पर देय चेक' बताया।

questions.question: Which Supreme Court case is noted for establishing that the Indian Constitution is founded on the 'bedrock of balance between Fundamental Rights (FRs) and DPSP'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In the Minerva Mill Case (1980), the Supreme Court emphasized that the Constitution is built on the balance between Part III (FRs) and Part IV (DPSP), where neither should be unduly sacrificed for the other

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मिनर्वा मिल मामले (1980) में, सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने जोर दिया कि संविधान भाग III (FRs) और भाग IV (DPSP) के बीच संतुलन पर बना है, जहाँ किसी को भी अनावश्यक रूप से दूसरे के लिए बलि नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।

questions.question:
Which sub-clause of Article 39 of the DPSP was added by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976?
DPSP

options.a: Art 39(b): That the ownership and control of the material resources...
options.b: Art 39(d): Equal pay for equal work for both sexes.
options.c: Art 39(e): Health and strength of workers, and children...
options.d: Art 39(f): Opportunities for healthy development of children.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 39(f), which focuses on securing opportunities for the healthy development of children, was one of the principles added to the DPSP by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment in 1976

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 39(f), जो बच्चों के स्वस्थ विकास के लिए अवसर सुरक्षित करने पर केंद्रित है, 1976 में 42वें संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा DPSP में जोड़े गए सिद्धांतों में से एक था।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): DPSPs are fundamental in the governance of the country and seek to establish Social and Economic democracy.
 Reason (R): DPSPs embody the concept of a Welfare State and emphasize societal welfare over individual welfare.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
DPSPs aim to achieve socio-economic justice, establishing social and economic democracy by moving towards the goal of a Welfare State, which naturally prioritizes the good of society as a whole. DPSP

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सामाजिक-आर्थिक न्याय प्राप्त करने का लक्ष्य रखते हैं, कल्याणकारी राज्य के लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़कर सामाजिक और आर्थिक लोकतंत्र स्थापित करते हैं, जो स्वाभाविक रूप से पूरे समाज की भलाई को प्राथमिकता देता है।

questions.question: Which Article of the DPSP, classified under the Liberal-Intellectual Principles, mandates the 'Separation of judiciary from the executive' in the public services of the state?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 50 deals specifically with the separation of the judicial and executive powers of the state. This principle is considered vital for ensuring the independence of the judiciary

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 50 विशेष रूप से राज्य की न्यायिक और कार्यकारी शक्तियों के पृथक्करण से संबंधित है। यह सिद्धांत न्यायपालिका की स्वतंत्रता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है।

questions.question: The DPSP regarding 'The state shall endeavour to promote voluntary formation, autonomous functioning, democratic control, and professional management of cooperative societies' (Art 43B) was added by which amendment?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 43B, dealing with cooperative societies, was added by the 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011. This amendment also granted a constitutional status and protection to cooperative societies

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सहकारी समितियों से संबंधित अनुच्छेद 43B को 97वें संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम, 2011 द्वारा जोड़ा गया था। इस संशोधन ने सहकारी समितियों को संवैधानिक दर्जा और संरक्षण भी प्रदान किया।

questions.question: Which DPSP Article states the state's duty is 'to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health' and is classified under the Socialistic Principles?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 47, which is a Socialistic principle, mandates the state's duty to improve public health and raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living, and also includes the prohibition of intoxicating drinks and drugs

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 47, जो एक समाजवादी सिद्धांत है, राज्य के कर्तव्य को सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य में सुधार करने और पोषण स्तर और जीवन स्तर को ऊपर उठाने का आदेश देता है, और इसमें नशीले पेय और दवाओं पर प्रतिबंध भी शामिल है।

questions.question: Which committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Swaran Singh Committee, in 1976, recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties during the time of the national emergency. Based on its recommendations, 10 duties were initially added by the 42nd CA

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वर्ण सिंह समिति ने 1976 में राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान मौलिक कर्तव्यों को शामिल करने की सिफारिश की थी। इसकी सिफारिशों के आधार पर, 42वें संशोधन द्वारा शुरू में 10 कर्तव्य जोड़े गए थे।

questions.question: Which one of the following is NOT a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A?

options.a: To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India.
options.b: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
options.c: To pay taxes and duties to the government.
options.d: To safeguard public property and to abjure violence.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Swaran Singh Committee had recommended the duty to pay taxes, but this recommendation was rejected and not included in the list of Fundamental Duties. The other options are present in Art 51A

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वर्ण सिंह समिति ने करों का भुगतान करने के कर्तव्य की सिफारिश की थी, लेकिन इस सिफारिश को अस्वीकार कर दिया गया और मौलिक कर्तव्यों की सूची में शामिल नहीं किया गया। अन्य विकल्प अनुच्छेद 51A में मौजूद हैं।
